automations.name: New Patient Follow-Up
automations.summary: When someone requests an appointment, this follows up with them by text, email, phone and voicemail over four days until your team confirms the visit.
glance: A new patient request is moved to “Requested Appointment” on your lead board
Day 4, after your team is alerted

steps.title: A new patient requests an appointment
steps.body: The follow-up starts when the request is moved to “Requested Appointment” on your lead board.

steps.title: A team member is assigned
steps.body: One person on your team becomes the patient’s contact. Their first name signs the texts below.

steps.title: Text 1: Thanks for your request
steps.sms: Hi [First name], thanks for requesting an appointment with Boca Dental. The next step is to get your appointment confirmed. Please either respond to this text or give us a call. We look forward to seeing you! [Team member's first name]
steps.note: This first text doesn’t include opt-out wording (“Reply STOP to opt out”). Many carriers expect it on the first message. We recommend adding it.

steps.title: Email 1: Thanks for requesting your appointment

email.subject: Thanks for requesting your appointment!
email.body:
Hi [First name],

Thanks for requesting an appointment with Boca Dental.

The next step is to get your appointment confirmed. Please reply to this email or text/call us at [Office text number] with any questions.

We look forward to seeing you!
[Team member's signature]

steps.title: Your office calls the patient
steps.body: Your office phone rings first. When someone answers, the system connects them to the patient so you can confirm a time while the request is fresh.

steps.title: Text 2: We haven’t been able to connect
steps.sms:
Hi [First name], I'm sorry that we haven't been able to connect. We do need to speak with you just to confirm the time of your appointment.

Feel free to reply to this message or just give us a quick call to get everything confirmed.

Thx!
[Team member's first name]
steps.note: This text goes out even if your team already reached the patient on Day 0, which would read oddly. See Question 1.

steps.title: Email 2: Following up

email.subject: Yesterday…
email.pending: Email wording coming soon. We’re adding it from your account.

steps.title: A recorded voicemail is left
steps.body: The patient gets a pre-recorded voicemail from your office. Their phone doesn’t ring. They just see a new voicemail.

steps.title: Text 3: Checking in one last time
steps.sms:
Hi [First name], I just wanted to check in one last time to see if you still wanted your requested appointment with us. I know life gets busy. :) Just let me know when you get a chance. Feel free to give any of us a call or just reply to this text.

Thanks!
[Team member's first name]

steps.title: Email 3: Confirming

email.subject: Confirming
email.pending: Email wording coming soon. We’re adding it from your account.

steps.title: Your team gets an email alert
steps.body: The assigned team member receives an email titled “New Lead - [First name] [Last name]”, and the patient’s card is updated on your lead board.
steps.note: This alert arrives 4 days after the request, and it’s labeled “New Lead”. Your team would usually want it on Day 0. See Question 2.

steps.title: The follow-up ends
steps.body: The patient leaves this automation and won’t receive these messages again.

questions.text: Should the follow-up stop as soon as the patient books or replies?
questions.why: Right now every patient gets all 8 messages, even after they’ve confirmed.

questions.text: Should your team be alerted on Day 0, when the request comes in?
questions.why: Today the alert arrives on Day 4.

questions.text: Are texts and calls between 9:00 AM and 8:00 PM okay?
options: Change the hours (tell us in a step comment)

automations.name: Lead Replies Alert
automations.summary: When a patient replies to one of the New Patient Follow-Up messages, your team is alerted right away and the patient is marked on your lead board.
glance: A patient replies to a New Patient Follow-Up text or email

steps.title: A patient replies
steps.body: Starts when a patient replies to any message from New Patient Follow-Up. Replies to other messages don’t count.

steps.title: The patient is marked on your lead board
steps.body: The patient’s card is created or updated on your lead board so you can see they’re engaged.

steps.title: Your team gets an email alert

email.subject: Includes the patient’s name
email.pending: Alert wording coming soon. We’re adding it from your account.

steps.note: Only your team sees this email.

steps.title: Your team takes it from here
steps.body: The automation ends. Your team replies to the patient.

automations.name: Existing Patient Alert
automations.summary: When an existing patient’s card is moved to a specific stage on your lead board, the assigned team member gets an email right away so nobody misses the follow-up.
glance: An existing patient’s card is moved to the chosen stage on your lead board

steps.title: An existing patient reaches the chosen stage
steps.body: Starts when an existing patient’s card is moved into the chosen stage on your existing-patient lead board. Cards in any other stage don’t trigger it.
steps.note: Tell us which stage this should watch (for example “Ready to Schedule”). We’ll confirm it matches your board.

steps.title: Your team gets an email alert

email.subject: Includes your office name and the patient’s full name
email.pending: Email wording coming soon. We’re adding it from your account.

steps.note: Only your team sees this email. It goes to the patient’s assigned team member.

steps.title: Your team takes it from here
steps.body: The automation ends. Nothing else is sent.

questions.why: Right now it goes to the patient’s assigned team member only.
options: Someone else (tell us in a step comment)

automations.name: Reactivation Follow-Up
automations.summary: Wins back patients you haven’t seen in a while. Over about three weeks they get friendly emails, texts, a voicemail and a special offer, and finally a short request for feedback.
glance: A past patient is added to this follow-up

steps.title: A past patient is added
steps.body: Patients enter this follow-up when your team adds them, for example from a list of patients who haven’t visited in 12 months.
steps.note: Nothing adds patients automatically yet. See Question 1.

steps.title: A team member is assigned
steps.body: One person on your team becomes the patient’s contact. Their first name signs the texts below.

steps.title: Email 1: We miss you!

email.subject: We Miss You!
email.pending: Email wording coming soon. We’re adding it from your account.

steps.title: Text 1: It’s been a while
steps.sms:
Hi [First name], I noticed you haven't been in to see us at Boca Dental for awhile. I know how busy life can be, but we want to make sure that your oral health is a priority. Regular dental visits help to prevent larger issues down the road!

Please reply to this text or call us & we would be happy to set up an appt.
[Team member's first name]

steps.title: Email 2: Reaching out about your appointment

email.subject: Reaching Out About Your Appointment
email.pending: Email wording coming soon. We’re adding it from your account.

steps.title: A recorded voicemail is left
steps.body: The patient gets a pre-recorded voicemail that sounds like a personal check-in from your office. Their phone doesn’t ring.

steps.title: Offer email: A discount for your next visit

email.subject: Bring this Discount to Your Next Appointment
email.pending: Email wording coming soon. We’re adding it from your account.

steps.title: Offer text: $50 gift card
steps.sms:
Hi [First name],

Did you know we are running a promotion right now? For a limited time, receive a $50 Amazon gift card after completing your next appointment!

This promotion does expire within the month, so please don't delay in scheduling!

Just mention this email when you give us a call for an appointment booking.

We look forward to seeing you again!
[Team member's first name]
steps.note: This is a text, but it says “mention this email”. We suggest changing it to “mention this text”. Please also confirm the $50 Amazon gift card offer is current.

steps.title: Email 4: Can we ask a favor?
steps.body: A short note asking why they haven’t been back and what you could do better.

email.subject: Can We Ask a Favor?
email.pending: Email wording coming soon. We’re adding it from your account.

steps.title: The follow-up ends
steps.body: The patient leaves this automation. All messages are sent during daytime hours (about 9 AM to 5 PM).

questions.text: How should patients be added to this follow-up?
questions.why: Right now someone on your team has to add them by hand.
options: Add everyone not seen in 12 months (recommended)

questions.text: Should the follow-up stop once a patient books or replies?
questions.why: Right now every patient gets all 7 messages.

automations.name: Reactivation Replies Alert
automations.summary: When a past patient replies to your reactivation messages, your team gets an email right away so you can call or text them back while they’re interested.
glance: A patient replies to a Reactivation Follow-Up message

steps.title: A past patient replies
steps.body: Starts when a patient replies to a message from your Reactivation Follow-Up.
steps.note: Our notes show this is set to watch for replies to itself instead of to Reactivation Follow-Up, so it may never fire. We’ll check it and point it at Reactivation Follow-Up.

steps.title: Your team gets an email alert

email.subject: Includes the patient’s full name
email.pending: Email wording coming soon. We’re adding it from your account.

steps.note: Goes to your main office email. One recipient slot is currently empty. See Question 1.

steps.title: Your team takes it from here
steps.body: The automation ends. Your team replies to the patient.

questions.text: Who else should get this alert besides the main office email?
questions.why: There’s an empty recipient slot in the current setup.
options: Add a specific person (tell us in a step comment)

automations.name: Website Enquiry Response
automations.summary: When someone enquires on your website, they get a text right away, your office phone rings with their details so you can connect instantly, and your team gets an email with the lead’s information.
glance: Someone submits a form on your website

steps.title: Someone enquires on your website
steps.body: Starts when a new enquiry comes in from your website form.
steps.note: The form trigger isn’t switched on yet. We’ll connect it to your website form before this goes live.

steps.title: Text: Thanks for reaching out
steps.sms:
Hi [First name], thanks for reaching out to Boca Dental.We will be following up with you soon. You can also give us a call at [Office phone]. We look forward to speaking with you.Thanks!
[Team member's first name]
steps.note: There’s a missing space after “Boca Dental.” and before “Thanks!”. We’ll fix both.

steps.title: Your office phone rings with the lead’s details
steps.body: When you answer, a short message reads out the person’s name, whether they’re a new or existing patient, and the reason for their visit. Press any key to be connected to them straight away.

steps.title: Your team gets an email with the lead’s details

email.subject: You have a new lead from your website!
email.pending: Email wording coming soon. We’re adding it from your account.

steps.note: Only your team sees this email.

steps.title: Your team takes it from here
steps.body: The automation ends. Your team follows up by phone, text or email.

questions.text: Which number should ring when a website enquiry comes in?
questions.why: We need the number your front desk answers during office hours.
options: Another number (tell us in a step comment)
